definitions.explanation: A person in the same class at school. Borrowed from English 'classmate.'

examples.japanese: クラスメートに{会|あ}った。
{高校|こうこう}のクラスメートと{久|ひさ}しぶりに{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got in touch with a high school classmate after a long time.

examples.japanese: クラスメートみんなで{先生|せんせい}に{寄|よ}せ{書|が}きを{贈|おく}ることにした。
examples.english: We decided as a class to give the teacher a signed message board.

notes:
A loanword from English 'classmate,' used for students in the same class at school. Typically refers to the same homeroom class rather than just taking the same course.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラスメートと{仲|なか}がいい: to be on good terms with classmates
- クラスメートに{相談|そうだん}する: to consult a classmate
- {元|もと}クラスメート: former classmate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同級生|どうきゅうせい}: classmate (same grade/year) — broader than クラスメート; includes all students in the same school year, not just the same class
- {学友|がくゆう}: school friend — more literary; emphasizes friendship rather than just being in the same class
